 About Tom Nield
 CountryEngland
 Recorded matches132
 Available seasons2022/2023 – 2026/2027
 Competitions6
 Tom Nield is an English referee born on April 21, 1991 in Wakefield, England. He began his refereeing career in the English Football League (EFL) in 2017 and has since officiated matches mainly in League One and League Two, with some appearances in the Championship.In addition to his role as a referee, Nield is known for his work as a nurse in the United Kingdom's National Health Service (NHS). During the COVID-19 pandemic, he reduced his refereeing commitments to dedicate himself full-time as an emergency nurse at the Mid Yorkshire Hospitals NHS Trust, demonstrating a remarkable commitment to the community.Regarding his refereeing style, Nield is recognized for his communicative approach and his ability to handle high-pressure situations with calmness. His experience in the healthcare sector has provided him with additional skills in managing people and stressful situations, which is reflected in his work on the field.
